purpose: Draws and edits the Qualifiers line of a Value card: each qualifier of the Scale (such as [Country]) with its options, definitions and default option, renaming, the preset qualifiers, the "Not in the Scale" warning and the conditions that can move into a qualifier, giving every change up whole through onChange.
namedChanges: Imports: `../../lib/base/planValue` and `../../lib/base/planValueModel` are `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-value-card-model` (each name was checked to be exported there: `blankVariable`, `carryOthers`, `carryRaw`, `listLikeDefinition`, `movableConditions`, `moveConditionIntoVariable`, `PRESET_QUALIFIERS`, `qualifierRows`, `renameCandidate`, `scaleQualifierNames` and the types `QualifierRow`, `ScaleVariable`); `../../lib/base/planCard` is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-plan-card-facts` (`planSourceEmpty`); the shared pieces above are from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-value-line-kit`. The symbols are otherwise unchanged.
Comments: the batch tags of the source's comments on `DEFAULT_BADGE` are removed, keeping the technical meaning.
`tsconfig.json` leaves out `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, which the app's source is not compiled with.

library.title: Qualifiers line of a Value card
library.note: Edits the Scale qualifiers and their options; to pick a qualifier's value take qualifier-value-picker. Plan.Value
